neighbours.label: A measured quantity or direction of change in a size claim (lift global sea levels by 30 cm, adjust upward, offset); plain sentences stay low
fire: The melting would lift global sea levels by half a metre.
Burning peat could raise carbon dioxide levels by ten percent.
The dam would lower river levels by about two metres.
Warming may push ocean levels up by a foot.
The new rule would cut mercury levels by a third.
Rain could raise groundwater levels by a few inches.
Drought will reduce lake levels by several feet.
Dredging would drop canal levels by one metre.
quiet: The melting snow fell off the roof near the door.
Burning leaves smell nice on a cold autumn day.
The dam was built by a Swiss firm long ago.
Warm weather may bring tourists to the coast.
The new rule was read out at the meeting.
Rain could fall on the hills in the evening.
Drought will come back in a year or two.
Dredging boats sat in the canal all week.

short: measured level changing by an amount
notes: Probes mostly under 0.03, with ' levels' 0.46, so this is at risk.
